Class CriticalPathOperations

java.lang.Object
org.example.CriticalPathOperations
public class CriticalPathOperations extends Object
This class handles operations related to calculating and processing the critical path in a production process. It builds operation trees based on given operations, calculates the depth of these trees, and prints them in the order of critical path.

  • Method Details

    • criticalPathOperations

      public static void criticalPathOperations(List<Item> items, List<Operation> operations, BooDataResult booDataResult)
      This method processes the critical path operations by building operation trees, calculating their depths, and printing the operations in the order of their critical path, from the most to the least critical.
      Parameters:
      items - The list of items involved in the operations.
      operations - The list of operations to be processed.
      booDataResult - The result data for the Bill of Operations (BOO), containing the mapping of operations to items and item quantities.

    • calculateTreeDepth

      public static int calculateTreeDepth(ProductionTreeNode node)
      Recursively calculates the depth of a production tree. The depth is defined as the longest path from the root node to any leaf node.
      Parameters:
      node - The root node of the tree whose depth is to be calculated.
      Returns:
      The depth of the tree.
